title: Add Semio No Ui Dependency Policy
description: Add a new semio policy with a NoUiDependency statute (not autofixable). Check that all semio.* files are self-contained and don't import from any UI dependency. Examples: semio.ts imports from tailwind-merge, semio.test.ts imports from semio-elements/ui.
summary: Added new "semio" policy with BreachSemioNoUiDependency statute (not autofixable, HIGH priority). The statute checks that all semio.* files are self-contained and do not import UI dependencies (clsx, tailwind-merge, three, react, semio-elements/ui, etc.). Added 10 comprehensive tests. Also fixed case-sensitivity bug in GraphQL Policy resolver.
